newsitem.title: UK: Black Sea, Baltic oil exports fall 277k bpd on wee.
newsitem.headline: Black Sea, Baltic oil exports fall 277k bpd on wee.

text.p: Oil exports from Baltic and Black Sea terminals fell 277,321 barrels a day (bpd) to 1.8 million bpd in the fourth week of January from the previous week but rose 330,460 bpd over the same week last year, Petro-Logistics said on Wednesday.

The Geneva-based consultancy, tracking tanker movements, said crude exports from the former Soviet Baltic and Black Sea ports fell 64,157 bpd on the week to 1.24 million bpd. This represented a rise of 291,701 bpd over the same period last year.
Fuel exports fell 85,104 bpd to 148,394 bpd but were 28,735 bpd higher than last year.
Gas oil exports fell 78,765 bpd to 389,501 bpd and included 15,481 bpd from Romania and Bulgaria. The amount was 2,275 bpd higher than the same period last year.
Gasoline and jet exports combined were 49,295 bpd lower on the week at 26,711 bpd but higher by 20,979 bpd over the same period last year.
